fixes.issue: M readiness admits a valid automatic field override whose behaviour the physical writer bypasses; cross-group flags used divergent checks
fixes.proof: Loaded declaration Migration.source autoCreatedAt:true is valid. Waterline writes an ISO source value while the driver used an empty default. Mutation controls also harden the shared flag invariant; not every mutated shape is a valid model declaration.

fixes.issue: Model timestamp writes bypass coercion and empty/null validation, and createdAt patches are dropped
fixes.proof: 772 initial timestamp differences across 1520 cases; six ordinary HarvestRecordEvent createdAt differences in the 7280 field cases. Explicit null/empty timestamps must fail; scalar boolean/number values follow loaded Waterline string coercion.

fixes.issue: Ledger names, numeric epochs and scalar metadata diverge from loaded model write/query coercion
fixes.proof: 42 differences in 102 inputs. Required/null/default rules now use the shared model codec. Stored malformed names remain a read error, rather than being silently repaired.

fixes.issue: Readiness accepts string physical IDs and incompatible referenced IDs while concrete encoders always use ObjectId
fixes.proof: 17 genuinely loaded dontUseObjectIds owner/foreign declarations were admitted. Physical reifier proof preserves string _id while driver creates ObjectId. Public IDs would miss or acquire duplicate physical identity across writers.

fixes.issue: J2 zero model pages become unbounded Mongo reads; J3 native cursor paging is incorrectly treated as a model page
fixes.proof: J2 zero returns an empty page before inspecting skip. Legacy unlimited forms remain supported. J3 native zero means unlimited and native signed/fraction behaviour is retained. HTTP positive-size clamping limits exposure of J2 zero; direct repository contract is clearly wrong.

fixes.issue: Ordinary scalar predicates, undefined optional filters and time bounds use incompatible per-group query logic
fixes.proof: 232 job, 38 R/Q/J1,12cache and4ledger-query-boundary before differences. Undefined optional values must be omitted rather than serialized as null. Boolean/numeric string comparisons must use the same scalar checker. Invalid/empty range shapes fail before query dispatch.

fixes.issue: Native dashboard CAS and SIEM delivery patches incorrectly run through model coercion/default/clock logic
fixes.proof: Five dashboard and four SIEM mismatches. Dashboard native CAS must preserve the supplied patch without injecting updatedAt; SIEM completion must generate its own updatedAt. Both selections now share each native operation. Plain finite JSON guard applies at the driver boundary, without introducing a baseline model codec.

fixes.issue: Model patches silently discard a supplied primary ID and can write other fields where Waterline rejects the entire update
fixes.proof: 76 differences across 228 actual loaded-model/official-driver create and patch cases, covering19models. Shared primary ID encoding now retains same-ID updates and immutable-ID refusal; invalid/null/empty primary IDs fail before writes.

fixes.issue: Record type exact wildcard field selection returns only id through both repository selections
fixes.proof: RecordTypesService.get/getAll fields:[*] is a valid unrestricted Waterline selection, but replacements lost every configuration field. Shared DTO/physical selection interpretation now preserves complete rows;12loaded comparisons cover omitted/null/wildcard onboth methods/adapters. Existing custom DTO field-list extension remains qualified by reference-contract rather than claimed as a schema:false model select comparison.

consolidation.purpose: Share byte-identical S service normalization plus common field/default/timestamp primitives. Preserve native schema inheritance and every gated owner.

notes: Per-fix checks run before their commits; sourceCommit names the parent checkpoint. Final accepted matrix runs at runtimeCommit.
No production source was changed and reverted for a before proof.
Finite plain JSON and scalar types remain the qualified driver boundary. Arbitrary unsupported legacy BSON is not silently coerced.
